description: Defines the processor_notifier_adaptor class which adapts various processor notifications for the lower physical layer in a radio communication system, including downlink, uplink, PRACH, PDxCH, and PUxCH notifiers.

classes.name: processor_notifier_adaptor
classes.description: Adapts various processor notifications to lower physical layer interfaces, encapsulating notifiers for downlink, uplink, PRACH, PDxCH, and PUxCH.

classes.name: downlink_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing downlink_processor_notifier, forwarding timing and metrics events.

classes.name: uplink_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing uplink_processor_notifier, forwarding slot and metrics events.

classes.name: pdxch_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing pdxch_processor_notifier, handling late request events.

classes.name: prach_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing prach_processor_notifier, handling PRACH request events.

classes.name: puxch_adaptor
